name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Web Developer & Website Manager | HTML/CSS, Technical SEO, Schema & Analytics
summary: Website builder and manager who handles the whole stack a small team needs: page builds, HTML/CSS customization, technical SEO and schema, analytics tracking, forms and integrations, and the email follow-up behind them. I built and maintain my own business site directly in HTML/CSS, install Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every client site I build, and run technical SEO audits with fixes implemented inside client CMS platforms. At Wix, I launched 25+ client sites a month, building e-commerce storefronts for retail businesses, and advised on site architecture, navigation, and SEO. I explain web decisions in plain language to non-technical teams.
